hints.title: Boundary Spill Limitation
hints.text: Water on a 2D surface is bounded by the minimum elevation along its spill path towards any grid boundary.

hints.title: Min-Heap Boundary Expansion
hints.text: Push all outer perimeter cells into an ordered min-priority collection and expand inwards from lowest elevation.

hints.title: Water Level Inward Flooding
hints.text: Extract the lowest boundary cell. For each unvisited orthogonal neighbor, add water equal to the difference between current boundary height and neighbor elevation if positive. Push neighbor into collection with height equal to max of current height and neighbor height.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Min-heap BFS traversing each cell once like Dijkstra shortest path.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Row-wise or column-wise 1D water trapping misses diagonal and multidirectional spill boundaries.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Min-heap prioritizing lowest boundaries ensures monotonic water containment.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use boundary min-heap BFS to propagate minimum spill heights inward.
